new_learnings.text: Rule 2b (MA-distance anti-chase) filtered 5+ visually strong candidates today: 思瑞浦(dist_ma5 9.1%), 芯源微(6.4%), 华锡有色(10.0%), 山东赫达(10.0%), 赛恩斯(8.5%). Only 兴森科技 passed all three MA checks. The rule is preventing chasing at extended prices.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that spike far above short-term MAs have high mean-reversion risk. The 6%/8%/12% thresholds create a safety buffer that improves risk/reward on entry.

new_learnings.text: Sector 元件 is emerging as a leadership sector with institutional participation. 风华高科涨停, 兴森科技创新高, multiple names running. PCB/components theme is broadening from pure semiconductor plays. Monitor for persistence.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector rotations often cascade from equipment → components → materials. Today's 元件 strength may be the second wave of a semicon-led rally.

new_learnings.text: 上海新阳's recovery from 6/12 (-6.17%) to 6/15 (+4.30%) validates the 3-consecutive-day cold-sector rule. Selling on day 1 of sector cold would have locked in losses. The rule gives sectors room to shake out weak hands before triggering exits.
new_learnings.mechanism: One-day sector dips in strong uptrends are often profit-taking, not regime changes. Requiring 3 consecutive cold days filters noise from signal.

new_learnings.text: 路维光电 +9.71% in 4 days approaching +10% mechanical stop-raise. The Rule 5 trailing-stop system is working: winners get room to run while risk is systematically reduced.
new_learnings.mechanism: Raising stops after +10% converts winning trades into risk-free holds, allowing the portfolio to benefit from continued momentum without risking original capital.
